endorsements.label: The Hacker Foundation: An Introduction
endorsements.description: The Hacker Foundation: An Introduction The Hacker Foundation (THF) is a non-profit organization dedicated to establishing and maintaining a research and service organization to promote and explore the creative use of technological resources. Simply put, we want to help people do useful things with technology. This announcement is a formal launch of the foundation. There will be a brief statement about the foundation's goals, operations and how the foundation can work for you.
